name: Barberà del Vallès (Spain)
description: Red field with two stripes along the lower edge, yellow above dark green, each one fifth of the height.
history: The flag was approved on 15 July 2001 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3448 of 8 August 2001; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red in allusion to the castle of the arms, with two juxtaposed stripes below, yellow and dark green, each 1/5 of the height, the dark green at the lower edge.
